assessment: This fundamental study demonstrates that the two isoforms of the ARPC5 subunit (ARPC5 and ARPC5L) of the Arp2/3 complex have specific functions in regulating cytoplasmic and nuclear actin filament assembly in response to DNA replication stress and T cell receptor signaling in T lymphocytes. The data presented in the manuscript are convincing and of good technical quality, and the study provides interesting new insights into specific cellular roles of different Arp2/3 isoforms in T lymphocytes.
